description: Every manual change applied on top of the automated pipeline. Each entry records the target, the original value, the corrected value, the kind of correction, the evidence, a confidence level, the reason and the date. The world builder refuses entries that lack any of these fields. All floor counts below were counted from the photograph published with the building's official HKU Campus Map entry; most photographs show only part of the building, so these are estimates, not surveyed values.
